notes.title: New Chapter Update
notes.notes:
[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Chapter 5
[*]'lever' tile
[*]'button' tile
[*]Special levels
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed many known bugs
[*]Textures and graphical changes
[*]Updated step limit for some levels
[*]Updated undo limit for some levels
[/list]

[h1]New Chapter[/h1]
In this new chapter, we added 2 puzzle element: the lever and button which can toggle the states of all other puzzle elements of the same color. The new chapter contains 38 new unique levels, with more to be added later!
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/aa1acaed8edcb5cc83a46b58caa68998900b4563.png[/img]

[h1]Special Levels[/h1]
New Special levels have been added for each chapter! They are special in that they involve some unusual challenges not found in normal levels.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/89e42e08a24f27f4f4a81c77dd542a5c958153db.png[/img]

[b]New Levels, New features, New challenges awaits![/b]

[h1]'Lever' Switch[/h1]
When there are objects on the lever, it will toggle the on/off state of all puzzle elements of the same color (such as players/boxes, portals, lasers, ect.) .  The disabled elements will cease functions until re enabled. When the object leaves the lever, the toggled state will remain until stepped on again.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/068669a72456cb9883c2afcf4231a833fb274ca1.png[/img]

[h1]'button' Switch[/h1]
Similar to the Lever, but the toggled state will revert when the object leaves
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/fe400af4481457470a430dc01785c0c627d07675.png[/img]

[h1]Simultaneous Activation [/h1]
There may be multiple levers/buttons in the same level, if multiple is activated at the same time, they will all trigger simultaneously.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/76a3661cf1df7ec141d57a95e79a45a06472c3f4.gif[/img]

[h1]Player? Box?[/h1]
When players are toggled off, they turn into boxes. You can use this to bypass damaging effects.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/873c607385474f5370543db497e9270b7aa9fbab.gif[/img]

Thats all for this update.

[b]We hope you all enjoy the game![/b]

notes.title: New Chapter Update!
notes.notes:
[h1]Added[/h1]
[list]
[*] Chapter 4 Levels
[*] Lasers
[*] Box
[/list]

[h1]Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fix rendering issues
[*] Removed auto restart
[*] Updated step limits
[*] Updated undo limits
[/list]

[h1][b]Added a brand new chapter![/b][/h1]
In this chapter, there are 2 new puzzle elements that interact with existing elements in interesting ways, featuring 43 new unique levels with more to come.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/7047d5d76812ecbfbd9f97418d36daa27b2654f7.png[/img]

New chapter, new challenges awaits!

[h1][b]New: Box blocks[/b][/h1]
They can be pushed by players, but do not move on their own.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/558a35b22ddd9d841105669c7ba98bb8cbd8fc70.png[/img]

They will ignore damage from other sources, which can be used to subvert danger.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/cac2a350f0e81a85af13f79223af2a6438f6eaa0.png[/img]


[h1][b]New: Lasers[/b][/h1]
They are emitted from players or boxes; be careful, they will destroy players.
They can be blocked by walls and boxes but will go through glass.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/63cfbadd53c2ffd1e92e9e54112d8217d9982344.png[/img]

They will go through portals, including getting duplicated by multiple exits.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/1634cc3da189bb20e505e4af979056efdd0cda1b.png[/img]

They can have different colors, which will interact with color changers, and have an explosive secret.
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33340319/1603509aecdda64205b91ca5f4be746e79169bbb.gif[/img]



This concludes the new features in this update,

[b]We hope for your continued support in the future to release more updates![/b]
